name: manual_5537a6
claim: A fix needs its own review: closing a finding is a change like any other and can be wrong in exactly the way the original defect was, so re-review corrections rather than marking the finding closed on the strength of having written a fix.

decisions.notes: On 2026-08-14 an Eng review correctly found that a verification function was hardcoded to the outbound target roots and would report success regardless of whether the inbound reconciliation did anything. The fix folded in was verify_gemini(root, only). An independent reviewer showed at 98 of 100 confidence that this signature still could not prove recoverability - no archive root and no receipt location, so a verifier cannot identify which archive to validate and can accept a replacement without proving recovery material exists. The correction satisfied the letter of the finding and missed its purpose.
